ffpa_try_building_natural_gas_rig_production_transition = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = ffpa_auto_pm_resources
			}
			state = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b050_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b050_trial }

				can_activate_production_method = {
					building_type = building_natural_gas_rig

				AND = { weekly_profit <= 0 is_subsidized = no }
				cash_reserves_ratio <= ffpa_auto_pm_low_cash_reserves
				state = { sg:engines = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
				state = { sg:electroniccomponents = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }

			state = { sg:gas = { state_goods_pricier < ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_output_ceiling } }

ffpa_try_building_renewable_energy_power_plant_production_transition = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = ffpa_auto_pm_energy
			}
			state = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b061_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b061_trial }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b061_manual_lock }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b061_g0217_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b061_g0217_osc_lock }
			}
			has_active_production_method = pm_wind_turbines
			state = {
				can_activate_production_method = {
					building_type = building_renewable_energy_power_plant
					production_method = pm_rudimental_photovoltaic_cells
				}
			}
			OR = {
				AND = { weekly_profit <= 0 is_subsidized = no }
				cash_reserves_ratio <= ffpa_auto_pm_low_cash_reserves
				state = { sg:batteries = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
				state = { sg:engines = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
				state = { sg:alloys = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
				state = { sg:rare_earths = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
			}
			state = { sg:global_electricity = { state_goods_pricier < ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_output_ceiling } }
		}
		state = {
			set_variable = ffpa_ap_b061_pending
			set_variable = { name = ffpa_ap_b061_pending_months value = 0 }
			set_variable = ffpa_pending_t1671
		}
		debug_log = "FFPA_PM|DOWN_CANDIDATE|t1671|building_renewable_energy_power_plant|pmg_base_building_renewable_energy_power_plant|pm_wind_turbines->pm_rudimental_photovoltaic_cells"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = ffpa_auto_pm_energy

	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_automation_basic
			}

				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b066_pending }

			state = {
				can_activate_production_method = {
					building_type = building_rye_farm
					production_method = pm_tools_disabled
				}
			}
			OR = {
				state = { NOT = { zw_trigger_aaap_state_workforce_low = yes } }
				state = { sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
			}
		}
		state = {
			set_variable = ffpa_ap_b066_pending
			set_variable = { name = ffpa_ap_b066_pending_months value = 0 }
			set_variable = ffpa_pending_t1124
		}

	}

		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_automation_basic

				}

ffpa_try_building_textile_mill_automation_transition = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_automation_basic
			}
			state = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_trial }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_manual_lock }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_g0260_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_g0260_osc_lock }
			}
			has_active_production_method = pm_mechanized_looms
			state = {
				can_activate_production_method = {
					building_type = building_textile_mill
					production_method = pm_traditional_looms
				}
			}
			OR = {
				state = { NOT = { zw_trigger_aaap_state_workforce_low = yes } }
				state = { sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier > ffpa_auto_pm_downgrade_input_price } }
			}
		}
		state = {
			set_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_pending
			set_variable = { name = ffpa_ap_b076_pending_months value = 0 }
			set_variable = ffpa_pending_t0836
		}
		debug_log = "FFPA_PM|DOWN_CANDIDATE|t0836|building_textile_mill|pmg_automation_building_textile_mill|pm_mechanized_looms->pm_traditional_looms"
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_automation_basic
			}
			state = {
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_pending }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_trial }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_manual_lock }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_g0260_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_ap_b076_g0260_osc_lock }
			}
			has_active_production_method = pm_automatic_power_looms
			state = {
				can_activate_production_method = {
					building_type = building_textile_mill
					production_method = pm_mechanized_looms
				}
			}
			OR = {

REPLACE:zw_effect_auto_pm_building_arms_industry = {
	if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_building_arms_industry }
			ordered_scope_building = {
				limit = {
				NOT = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_guard_b005 = yes }
					is_building_type = building_arms_industry
					level >= 1
					
						
						
						trigger_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_bolt_action_rifles }
							always = no
						}
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_arms_industry
										production_method = pm_bolt_action_rifles
									}
								}
								trigger_if = {
									limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_repeaters }
									state = {
										sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:oil = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									}
								}
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								trigger_else = {
									
									state = {
										sg:steel = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:oil = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									}
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_repeaters }
							always = no
						}
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_arms_industry
										production_method = pm_repeaters
									}
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
									
									
										sg:steel = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_rifles }
							always = no
						}
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_arms_industry
										production_method = pm_rifles
									}
								
								
									
									
										sg:steel = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					
				}
				order_by = {
					subtract = level
				}
				min = 0
				max = {
					value = scope:zw_scope_auto_pm_num
				}
				check_range_bounds = no
				
				
				if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_bolt_action_rifles }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_arms_industry
								production_method = pm_bolt_action_rifles
							}
						}
						trigger_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_repeaters }
							state = {
								sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
								sg:oil = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							}
						}
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						trigger_else = {
							
							state = {
								sg:steel = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
								sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
								sg:oil = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							}
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_arms_industry
							production_method = pm_bolt_action_rifles
						}
					}
				}
				
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_repeaters }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_arms_industry
								production_method = pm_repeaters
							}
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
							
							
								sg:steel = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
								sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_arms_industry
							production_method = pm_repeaters
						}
					}
				}
				
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_rifles }
				}
				else = {
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_arms_industry
							production_method = pm_rifles
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_upstream_scan_logged } }
		debug_log = "FFPA_PM|UPSTREAM_PRODUCTION_SCAN|Auto-Apply PMs scheduler reached adapter"
		set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_upstream_scan_logged value = 1 months = 1 }
	}
	ordered_scope_building = {
		limit = { is_building_type = building_arms_industry level >= 1 ffpa_can_building_arms_industry_production_transition = yes }
		order_by = { subtract = level }
		min = 0
		max = { value = scope:zw_scope_auto_pm_num }
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_guard_b005 = yes owner = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_production_guard_logged } } }
			debug_log = "FFPA_PM|PRODUCTION_GUARD|building_arms_industry|upstream handler delegated this bidirectionally managed instance"
			owner = { set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_production_guard_logged value = 1 months = 1 } }
		}
		ffpa_try_building_arms_industry_production_transition = yes
	}
}

REPLACE:zw_effect_auto_pm_building_fishing_wharf = {
	if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_building_fishing_wharf }
			ordered_scope_building = {
				limit = {
				NOT = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_guard_b028 = yes }
					is_building_type = building_fishing_wharf
					level >= 1
					
						
						
						trigger_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_steam_trawlers }
							always = no
						}
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_fishing_wharf
										production_method = pm_steam_trawlers
									}
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
									
									
										sg:steamers = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:coal = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_fishing_trawlers }
							always = no
						}
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_fishing_wharf
										production_method = pm_fishing_trawlers
									}
								
								
									
									
										sg:clippers = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						trigger_else = { always = no }
					
				}
				order_by = {
					subtract = level
				}
				min = 0
				max = {
					value = scope:zw_scope_auto_pm_num
				}
				check_range_bounds = no
				
				
				if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_steam_trawlers }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_fishing_wharf
								production_method = pm_steam_trawlers
							}
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
							
							
								sg:steamers = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
								sg:coal = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_fishing_wharf
							production_method = pm_steam_trawlers
						}
					}
				}
				
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_fishing_trawlers }
				}
				else = {
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
				
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_fishing_wharf
							production_method = pm_fishing_trawlers
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_upstream_scan_logged } }
		debug_log = "FFPA_PM|UPSTREAM_PRODUCTION_SCAN|Auto-Apply PMs scheduler reached adapter"
		set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_upstream_scan_logged value = 1 months = 1 }
	}
	ordered_scope_building = {
		limit = { is_building_type = building_fishing_wharf level >= 1 ffpa_can_building_fishing_wharf_production_transition = yes }
		order_by = { subtract = level }
		min = 0
		max = { value = scope:zw_scope_auto_pm_num }
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_guard_b028 = yes owner = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_production_guard_logged } } }
			debug_log = "FFPA_PM|PRODUCTION_GUARD|building_fishing_wharf|upstream handler delegated this bidirectionally managed instance"
			owner = { set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_production_guard_logged value = 1 months = 1 } }
		}
		ffpa_try_building_fishing_wharf_production_transition = yes
	}
}

REPLACE:zw_effect_auto_pm_building_furniture_manufactory = {
	if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zw_var_auto_pm_building_furniture_manufactory }
			ordered_scope_building = {
				limit = {
				NOT = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_guard_b030 = yes }
					is_building_type = building_furniture_manufactory
					level >= 1
					OR = {
						
						
						trigger_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_mechanized_workshops }

							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_furniture_manufactory
										production_method = pm_mechanized_workshops
									}
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
								
									
									
										sg:wood = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
										sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									
								}
							}
							always = yes
						}
						
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_lathe }
							always = no
						}
						trigger_else_if = {
							limit = {
								state = {
									can_activate_production_method = {
										building_type = building_furniture_manufactory
										production_method = pm_lathe
									}
								
								
									
									
										sg:tools = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
									
								}
							}

								production_method = pm_electric_trains
							}
							has_building = building_power_plant
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
							
							
								sg:electricity = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_railway
							production_method = pm_electric_trains
						}
					}
				}
				
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_steam_trains_principle_transport_3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_railway
								production_method = pm_steam_trains_principle_transport_3
							}
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
							
							
								sg:engines = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
								sg:coal = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_railway
							production_method = pm_steam_trains_principle_transport_3
						}
					}
				}
				
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_steam_trains }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_railway
								production_method = pm_steam_trains
							}
						
						
							
							
								sg:coal = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_railway
							production_method = pm_steam_trains
						}
					}
				}
				
				
				if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_steel_passenger_carriages }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_railway
								production_method = pm_steel_passenger_carriages
							}
						
						
						
						
						
						
						
							
							
								sg:steel = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_railway
							production_method = pm_steel_passenger_carriages
						}
					}
				}
				
				else_if = {
					limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_wooden_passenger_carriages }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						state = {
							can_activate_production_method = {
								building_type = building_railway
								production_method = pm_wooden_passenger_carriages
							}
						
						
							
							
								sg:wood = { state_goods_pricier < zw_value_price_3 }
							
						}
					}
					state = {
						activate_production_method = {
							building_type = building_railway
							production_method = pm_wooden_passenger_carriages
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_upstream_scan_logged } }
		debug_log = "FFPA_PM|UPSTREAM_PRODUCTION_SCAN|Auto-Apply PMs scheduler reached adapter"
		set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_upstream_scan_logged value = 1 months = 1 }
	}
	ordered_scope_building = {
		limit = { is_building_type = building_railway level >= 1 ffpa_can_building_railway_production_transition = yes }
		order_by = { subtract = level }
		min = 0
		max = { value = scope:zw_scope_auto_pm_num }
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_guard_b059 = yes owner = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_production_guard_logged } } }
			debug_log = "FFPA_PM|PRODUCTION_GUARD|building_railway|upstream handler delegated this bidirectionally managed instance"
			owner = { set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_production_guard_logged value = 1 months = 1 } }
		}
		ffpa_try_building_railway_production_transition = yes
	}
}

REPLACE:zw_effect_change_state_pm_automation = {
	ordered_scope_building = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_automation_guard = yes }
				level >= 1
				zw_trigger_auto_pm_automation = yes
			}
			order_by = {
				subtract = level
			}
			min = 0
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			zw_effect_auto_pm_automation = yes
		}
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_automation_scan_logged } }
			debug_log = "FFPA_PM|UPSTREAM_AUTOMATION_SCAN|Auto-Apply Automation PMs scheduler reached adapter"
			set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_automation_scan_logged value = 1 months = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_scope_building = { ffpa_auto_pm_upstream_automation_guard = yes }
			owner = { NOT = { has_variable = ffpa_pm_automation_guard_logged } }
		}
		debug_log = "FFPA_PM|AUTOMATION_GUARD|upstream automation handler delegated bidirectionally managed instances"
		owner = { set_variable = { name = ffpa_pm_automation_guard_logged value = 1 months = 1 } }
	}
	ffpa_process_state_techres_automation = yes
}
